# XY Forever serial protocol 1.13: status codes and commands

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.13](../PROTOCOL.md).

## Status codes

Every reply starts with one. A tool shows a code it does not know by number and treats it as a failure. Besides the errors listed under each command, these can
come to any command, as the status alone (whatever its `on_error` says): `state`, to any command but `hello`: the device has not answered a `hello` since it
started; nothing was done. `unsupported`, to any command but `hello`: this build does not answer the type (it is not in `cmds`). `busy`, to any command but
`hello`: a job is running, or its write window is still closing after `job.status` said it ended: every command that needs processor A, the staging or a boot
waits for it (`diag.status`, `screen.read`, `service.hold`, `job.status` and `job.cancel` are answered).

| Code | Name | Since | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `ok` | 1.0 | done |
| 1 | `bad_request` | 1.0 | malformed request: wrong length, a value out of its allowed set, an invalid path or id |
| 2 | `unsupported` | 1.0 | this build does not answer this type (named `unknown` before 1.1) |
| 3 | `state` | 1.0 | wrong order: no `hello` yet, nothing staged, staging incomplete; the same request will not succeed until something else changes |
| 4 | `range` | 1.0 | an offset or address outside what the command allows |
| 5 | `crc` | 1.0 | a CRC-32 differs (staged data, or a written file read back) |
| 6 | `sha` | 1.0 | a SHA-256 differs (staged data or the confirmation token) |
| 7 | `storage` | 1.0 | a file-system call on the device failed |
| 8 | `not_found` | 1.0 | no such file |
| 9 | `too_large` | 1.0 | a size above its limit (staging capacity, boot partition, whole-file read) |
| 10 | `image` | 1.0 | the staged image is not acceptable for this install |
| 11 | `install` | 1.0 | the boot-partition write or its read-back check failed |
| 12 | `link` | 1.0 | processor A did not answer a request processor B passed on to it |
| 13 | `identity` | 1.0 | stock code in the device's memory differs from the checked bootloader image; the command did not run |
| 14 | `refused` | 1.1 | well formed, but forbidden by the device's safety policy (a path the file engine refuses, or, for a change, outside the write area: since 1.13 all of `/yaffs2/` except `/yaffs2/bootloader.dev` and `/yaffs2/upgrade` with all below it) |
| 15 | `busy` | 1.10 | a job (`mods.apply`) is running, or B is still closing A's write window after it ended (seconds); retry later, or `job.cancel` a running job |
| 16 | `cancelled` | 1.1 | the job was cancelled (not sent by any command yet) |
| 17 | `no_content` | 1.10 | the library entry's content is not installed in `/yaffs2/content/` (a mod set built on the device, or any entry while another one's content is installed): it is listed but does not boot as it is; make it the default to install its content |
| 18 | `started` | 1.10 | the request started a job (`library.set_default`: the content switch); follow it with `job.status`, whose end is the request's result |
| 19 | `declined` | 1.11 | the user refused the command at the device's Confirm on device prompt, or nobody answered it in time; nothing was done (not sent by any command yet: the prompt is not built) |

## Commands

| Type | Name | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 0x01 | [`hello`](cmd-session.md#0x01-hello) | greet the device; required before any other command |
| 0x03 | [`file.read`](cmd-session.md#0x03-fileread) | read a file, whole (at most 4096 bytes) or a range |
| 0x04 | [`screen.read`](cmd-session.md#0x04-screenread) | read part of the display framebuffer (screenshot) |
| 0x10 | [`stage.begin`](cmd-stage.md#0x10-stagebegin) | announce an image to stage in RAM |
| 0x11 | [`stage.data`](cmd-stage.md#0x11-stagedata) | send the next piece of the staged image |
| 0x12 | [`stage.end`](cmd-stage.md#0x12-stageend) | check the staged image against its CRC-32 and SHA-256 |
| 0x13 | [`file.write_staged`](cmd-stage.md#0x13-filewrite_staged) | write the staged image to a file under /yaffs2/ (the write area) |
| 0x14 | [`file.list`](cmd-files.md#0x14-filelist) | list one folder, a page at a time |
| 0x15 | [`file.delete`](cmd-files.md#0x15-filedelete) | delete one file |
| 0x16 | [`file.rmdir`](cmd-files.md#0x16-filermdir) | remove one empty folder |
| 0x17 | [`file.mkdir`](cmd-files.md#0x17-filemkdir) | create one folder |
| 0x18 | [`file.rename`](cmd-file-move.md#0x18-filerename) | rename or move one file or folder |
| 0x19 | [`file.copy`](cmd-file-move.md#0x19-filecopy) | copy one file on the device |
| 0x20 | [`boot.install`](cmd-boot.md#0x20-bootinstall) | install the staged XY Forever build into the boot partition |
| 0x21 | [`boot.uninstall`](cmd-boot.md#0x21-bootuninstall) | put the stock 1.2.1 os.ldr back into the boot partition |
| 0x30 | [`device.reboot`](cmd-boot.md#0x30-devicereboot) | restart both processors |
| 0x31 | [`menu.continue`](cmd-boot.md#0x31-menucontinue) | leave the menu and boot the default firmware |
| 0x32 | [`service.hold`](cmd-boot.md#0x32-servicehold) | keep the device in the menu across restarts |
| 0x40 | [`library.set_default`](cmd-library.md#0x40-libraryset_default) | make a library entry the default firmware |
| 0x41 | [`tfw.check`](cmd-library.md#0x41-tfwcheck) | check that a firmware package on the device is official and that the device's own keys open it |
| 0x43 | [`library.boot`](cmd-library.md#0x43-libraryboot) | boot a library entry once, as PLAY on it in the library menu |
| 0x44 | [`mods.apply`](cmd-jobs.md#0x44-modsapply) | start assembling mod firmware on the device (a job) |
| 0x45 | [`job.status`](cmd-jobs.md#0x45-jobstatus) | progress of the running or last job |
| 0x46 | [`job.cancel`](cmd-jobs.md#0x46-jobcancel) | stop the running job |

A typical session: `hello`; then reads (`file.read`, `screen.read`); to write, `stage.begin`, `stage.data` in order, `stage.end`, then one of
`file.write_staged`, `boot.install`, `boot.uninstall`.
